title: Trace of a left fold over the input
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$, let $A$ be a state type, choose a function $\delta:A\times\Gamma\to A$, an initial state $a_0\in A$, and a configuration $d$ of the fold machine on input $x$. Suppose $d$ is in the forward phase carrying $a_0$ and its input head is at position $1$. For every $t\in\mathbb N$, the machine's configuration after $t$ steps is the piecewise trace that equals the forward configuration formed using the fold of the first $t$ symbols for $t\le |x|$, the backward configuration carrying the fold of all of $x$ and indexed by $2|x|+1-t$ for $|x|<t\le 2|x|+1$, and the configuration in the done phase carrying the fold of all of $x$ for $t>2|x|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is in the forward phase carrying $a_0$
